Frequently Asked Questions

Why do heavy trucks use 24V?

24V systems halve the current for the same power, allowing thinner wiring and more reliable starting of large diesel engines.

Can I replace one battery of a 24V pair?

It is strongly recommended to replace both batteries as a matched pair to ensure balanced charging and full service life.
